messages:
ash: noticed invoice-preview spike during nightly batch (01:00 UTC). looks like duplicate token lines for same request_id across routes.
vivek: paste an example?
ash: ```text
[01:02:11Z] evt=ev12 req=rq_55 route=gpu-pro tokens=150
[01:02:11Z] evt=ev13 req=rq_55 route=gpu-pro-fb tokens=150
```
dana: we added route_key to the aggregator grouping last deploy to support per-route quotas — this would split forked requests.
iris: edge emits request_id + optional parent_id for forks; parent_id isn't in the billing event schema yet.
metering-bot: NOTICE: ingest schema v4 includes route_key grouping.
vivek: short fix: consumer-level collapse when request_id identical AND model_alias identical within same-second window for affected batch windows.
ash: I'll run a targeted backfill for last 12h and open ticket ENGPLAT-2120.
metering-bot: ACTION CREATED: tickets/ENGPLAT-2120 by ash - "route-fork-dedupe-backfill".
dana: long-term: add provenance_id and have edge compute it deterministically; then group by provenance_id.
iris: agree, will draft schema + rollout plan.
ash: assigning owners in ENGPLAT-2120. will update CS after backfill completes. :thumbsup:
